requirement: DanceFlow policy: before registration opens an edition may be selected or corrected with an audit record; after registrations begin only a controlled amendment (impact assessment, authorization, revalidation of affected entries, divisions and schedules); after competition activity begins no ordinary switching, only a separately authorized versioned exceptional correction that preserves original evidence and never recalculates history.
interpretation_notes: Owner decision OD-30 items 4-5. The list of signals that mean 'competition activity has begun' is open (design Q2). Design only: nothing implemented.
